title: Architecture
description: A building or another line-filled structure. The building stays sharp. Sky beside it can be treated differently, and it is not a reason to blur the facade or to invent a subject. When water holds a reflection of the building, that mirror is sharpened and lifted a little.
reason: The building is the subject and it fills the frame, so the structure stays sharp and no background is invented. A reflection in the water is made bolder than the water around it.

features.building: The building stays sharp. The facade is not cut out and is not blurred.
features.sky: Sky beside the building can be treated differently, and it is not turned into a subject.
